programs.title: Golden State Killer: Main Suspect
programs.desc: After a decadeslong crime spree terrorizes California, a DNA breakthrough leads detectives to a suspect in one of the most famous cases in history; Stephanie Gosk and detective Paul Holes trace the life of suspect Joe DeAngelo.

programs.desc: The long-lost confession tapes of the man who claimed to be the Boston Strangler have been uncovered. Suppressed for decades, these exclusive tapes reignite doubts about his confession, inspiring experts to reexamine the evidence and suspects.

programs.title: The Killer Among Us

programs.desc: When a missing man's bullet-riddled body is found off the side of a road, police must dig into his complicated past to uncover the truth; the case hits a standstill until information about the victim's car comes to light and reveals a toxic romance.

programs.title: Snapped: Killer Couples
programs.desc: When a shocking crime is committed in broad daylight that leaves a young man dead on the street, the investigation uncovers a personal vendetta; in exclusive prison interviews, the killer couple each share their version of events.

programs.title: Snapped: Killer Couples
programs.sub_title: Amanda Lothery and Rajhi T.C. Render
